scope: One offline image-to-3D request through a newly started Linux container HTTP server; not a fresh build of the repository Dockerfile or a latency distribution.
environment: New Python 3.11 virtual environment with --system-site-packages on an existing GPU-enabled image. Runtime and server requirements installed into the virtual environment. The inherited base package yue2-infer reported incompatible numpy and safetensors versions; no claim of a conflict-free environment.
encoder_precision: Original cached DINOv3 and FLUX.2 autoencoder; no separately supplied quantized encoders.
settings: Default staged server, no fused kernels, no resident GPU flag, 50 steps, seed 42, 262144 Gaussian points. Model loading is included.
allocation_limitations: PyTorch allocation excludes GPU context, unused reserved memory, other processes, and any image generator.
dockerfile_build: Not completed: interrupted when Docker storage volume became low on free space.
